# Textarea

Enter a large amount of text over multiple lines.
See [Textarea guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/textarea/design/)

The `ds-textarea` CSS class is to be used on `<textarea>` elements.

Modifier classes are provided which affect the color or the size.
